say: THE ONE TAG SET (owner, 23 Nov, UNIFY AFTER 6): every card that shows tags (Find's cards, the question card, the Sunday email) wears only these kinds of tag, at most one of each, in this order, and never more than `max`. Each kind is the first of its `fields` (data/settings/facets.json) the thing has. `join` makes the kind's fields one tag (Q1 a i is the one number Q1ai). Left out on purpose: What for / What kind / Which (Learning, Practice, Questions say the same thing three ways), Key stage beside a Level (GCSE and KS4), Answer checked (the library's own bookkeeping), the paper's date and section, and every other facet: those stay Find's filters, not tags. Picked by tagsKept_ (js/find-figures.js), the site's and the email's one picker; tools/one-tag-set.js holds every card to it.
